references.text: Moses goes up to God on the mountain, and the Lord calls to him—a pattern repeated here at Sinai
Moses goes up on Mount Sinai after the Lord called him, the same event from another perspective
Moses is again called up to the Lord on the mountain to receive instructions
Moses goes up on Mount Sinai to the Lord, as he was commanded
The expression 'house of Jacob' and 'children of Israel' is used for God's people
The prophet uses the same parallel expressions 'house of Jacob' and 'house of Israel'
Moses reminds the people that the Lord spoke to them from the mountain
Stephen refers to Moses on Mount Sinai who received living words to pass on to Israel
The letter to the Hebrews refers to the event at Mount Sinai where God spoke to Moses
Both verses mark the transition from God's direct revelation on the mountain to the mediated law for the people.
